newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telmex '97 estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telmex '97 estimate cut.

text.p: --Lehman Brothers said Monday it reduced its 1997 earnings estimate for Telefonos de Mexico SA to $3.35 from $3.76 per American Depositary Share (ADS) but reiterated its outperform rating on the stock.
--The firm said its previous estimate was substantially above market consensus. "The new estimate remains marginally above consensus estimates of $3.30 for 1997," the firm said.

--"The reduction is based on an adjustment to our assumptions regarding pricing of domestic long distance service plus an adjustment to our assumptions relating to market share," Lehman analyst Matthew Hickman said in the firm's daily research fax.
--Its target price for the stock is $40/ADS.
--Telmex ADSs fell 1/4 to 32-3/4 in thin midday trade.
